'''Nightwing''' was a [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by a member of the [[Thaereian military|Thaereian Navy]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in order to protect his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
